name: Sir Cedric Flinch
acting: Worried glance toward the blade and compressed mouth.
personality: Even his backup plan is wearing a helmet.
bio: Cedric guards a HyperNorm gate whose official threat level has never dropped below magnificent. He checks the sword before every shift because the gate has no hinges.
note: I asked him which side of the gate was safe. He indicated the shield.
call: After you. A little farther after you.
voice: Dignified low voice that catches at the end.

name: Orlo Spindle
acting: Uneven lids and a small startled O aimed at the orb.
personality: Trusts a spell right up to the moment it replies.
bio: Orlo was hired to teach an orb to summarize unwelcome evidence. It now gives the evidence twice and pauses for questions.
note: He has begun referring to the orb as a colleague so he can formally ignore it.
call: That was supposed to be a footnote.
voice: Measured scholar who breaks into a squeak.

name: Vera Cutpurse
acting: Low asymmetric lids and a knowing half-smile.
personality: Can take a thing so politely that the receipt feels rude.
bio: Vera steals only items that the Men in Black have formally declared never existed. Her bag has become too heavy to deny.
note: I searched the pouch. She helpfully returned my watch before I asked.
call: Nothing missing that you can prove.

name: Rowan Featherdraw
acting: One eye shut along the arrow with lips held flat.
personality: Treats a false target as a waste of good fletching.
bio: Rowan tracks contradictions through the scrub around HyperNorm. She marks the places where the official tracks double back.
note: The arrow was straighter than any account of what happened next.
call: Hold still. The story keeps moving.

name: Bram Stillbell
acting: Closed eyes and a soft, composed smile.
personality: Can remain tranquil while everybody else fills in a complaint form.
bio: Bram rings one note whenever a HyperNorm instruction contradicts itself. He was transferred to a room with excellent soundproofing.
note: His official response time is one breath. The appeal takes considerably longer.

name: Hob Hornwhistle
acting: Proud downcast glance and a big one-tooth laugh.
personality: Finds the beast's poor judgment reassuringly familiar.
bio: Hob trained a horned creature to find censored evidence. It currently finds his lunch and a little more evidence than necessary.
note: The companion's official job title is Assistance. Its teeth are informal.
